general.notes: Power dissipation stated as < 3.5 W. Aggregate bit rate 41.3 Gb/s; ordering lists 40 Gb/s. Lane wavelengths given as four CWDM ranges (1264.5–1277.5, 1284.5–1297.5, 1304.5–1317.5, 1324.5–1337.5 nm). Title/marketing uses 1310 nm; ordering 1271~1331 nm. Transmitter: uncooled 4×10 Gb/s CWDM (4 lasers); receiver: 4 photodetectors at up to 10.3125 Gb/s. RXPx min -21.2 dBm informative; max -4.5 dBm based on min 9 dB loss. Transmitter Dispersion Penalty (TDP) max 2.6 dB; vertical eye closure penalty max 2.2 dB per lane. Return Loss (RL) -26 dB at receiver. Optical Return Loss Tolerance 20 dB (transmitter). Average launch power OFF transmitter per lane max -30 dBm. Relative Intensity Noise (RIN) typ -128 dB/Hz (scaled per footnote 3). Difference in launch power between any two lanes (OMA) max 4.7 dB. Launch power (OMA) minus TDP per lane min -0.5 dBm. Receive Power (OMA) per lane max -4.0 dBm. Damage Threshold (DT) per lane 3.8 dBm matches optical PMAX. Vendor identified from repeated www.qsfptek.com on datasheet.

general.suggestions: Emitter is described only as uncooled CWDM lasers (no DFB/FP/APD/PIN). No explicit modulation format, FEC, OSNR, or chromatic-dispersion tolerance in ps/nm despite TDP. Penalty table rows (TDP, VECP) lack the @-condition triples required for penalties[]. Consider mapping RL -26 dB to receiver_reflectance_db if that is intended as reflectance.
